description: This file defines an abstract servlet filter class 'StartupFilter' used as a startup or initialization wizard component in the OpenMRS web application. It handles early request processing, file serving during startup, template rendering with Velocity, and provides hooks for subclasses to implement specific GET/POST logic during setup.

classes.name: StartupFilter
classes.description: An abstract servlet filter class used during the OpenMRS startup process, providing essential methods for request filtering, template rendering, and startup checks. Designed as a base for specific startup filters like initialization or update filters.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Main method intercepting HTTP requests during startup, handling health checks, static resource serving, redirection to setup, and delegating to subclasses for GET/POST processing.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter, setting up Velocity engine for template processing.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleanup method when filter is destroyed (empty in this implementation).

methods.name: getTemplatePrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix path for Velocity templates used during rendering.

methods.name: getUpdateFilterModel
methods.description: Abstract method to provide the backing model object for pages.

methods.name: skipFilter
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if the filter should be skipped for a request.

methods.name: renderTemplate
methods.description: Renders a Velocity template with the provided context, merging private class fields into the template context.

methods.name: addLogLinesToResponse
methods.description: Adds the last 5 log lines from OpenMRS logging to the response for debugging.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Converts a Java object (Map, List, String, etc.) into a JSON string for client-side use.

methods.name: getToolContext
methods.description: Provides a Velocity ToolContext configured with localization tools for rendering templates with proper locale support.
